text:
caleb: noticed a billing spike for several HW partners this morning. looks like identical hourly batches replayed from edge boxes -> double entitlements for some customers.
liz: confirmed. top-level: ~45k embedding units and ~300k tokens over-reported across 7 partners between 03:10-05:40 UTC.
caleb: root cause from partner logs: their devices hit an ack timeout, retried entire batch, then gateway deduplicator downstream failed to drop duplicates because fingerprint algorithm mismatched (sha1 vs sha256).
samir: we need a short-term kill-switch and a robust long-term dedupe fix. short term: drop obvious exact-duplicates by (device_id + batch_id + batch_checksum) on ingest. if checksum missing, drop if payload_bytes identical and timestamp within 1m.
maria-billing: agree on short term but billing needs records of what we drop vs what we accept. create a "dedupe_flag" transaction type that marks lines for review.
legal-bot: legal: any automatic reversal must be logged; customers need a notice if a reversal touches invoiced amounts. defer auto-credit on invoices until reconciler confirms.
liz: proposed ingest changes: accept header `X-Edge-Batch: <batch_id>` and optional `X-Edge-Checksum: sha256:<hex>`. server will compute checksum if absent and set internal flag `dedupe_source=ingest`. sample header:``
X-Edge-Batch: 2026-03-21T03:04:00Z-1234
X-Edge-Checksum: sha256:9c4f...
```
caleb: For older devices that can't send checksum, fallback: compute rolling-hash of first 512 bytes and compare, then mark candidate duplicates at low-confidence.
samir: implementation plan:
- ingest: new dedupe middleware v1.2 that indexes (device_id,batch_id,checksum) to redis with 48h TTL.
- if hit -> route to dedupe-drop stream and emit metric edge_dedupe_drop_total.
- if no checksum -> route to dedupe-review stream for fuzzy compare.
- add header `X-Redwood-Dedupe: dropped|fuzzy|accepted` to downstream events.
- reconciler: a backfill job to identify affected invoices and mark pending_reversal if earlier than invoice_close_date.

maria-billing: UX: invoices should show a pending_reversal line with explanation "duplicate batch detected; pending review". If confirmed, reversal posts as credit the following billing cycle.

liz: tests: seed staging with (1) exact duplicate replays (2) near-duplicate reorderings (3) checksum-missing bursts. Expect dedupe drop rate >99% for exact duplicates, fuzzy false-positive <0.1%.

caleb: alerts: create immediate PagerDuty for edge_dedupe_drop_total > 10k/min or if dedupe_review_queue > 5k. Also alert if dedupe_mismatch_rate > 0.5% for >10m.
samir: I'll open PRs: ingress middleware + redis index + topic reroute. ETA: first canary in us-east-1 in 24h.
maria-billing: I'll draft invoice language and flagging UI. ETA 3 business days.
legal-bot: require partner to adopt checksum header within 30 days; if they can't, escalate to integration team for device upgrades.
liz: partner coordination: scheduling call w/ partner HW-infra for Tue 9am PT. we'll share logs and sample test vectors.

ops-bot: ticket created: PART-9182 "edgebox duplicate-batch: ingest dedupe + reconciler" assigned to samir, rollout plan pending.

caleb: action items recap:
- samir: PR for middleware + metrics + alerts (ETA 24h)
- liz: partner call + test vectors (ETA 48h)
- maria-billing: invoice pending_reversal UX + reporting (ETA 72h)
- legal-bot: draft partner checksum requirement (ETA 72h)

zipped follow-ups: please add any missing edge cases. thanks everyone, we should aim to quarantine duplicates and avoid mass auto-credits until reconciler confirms. :shield:
